name: Porto Beer Fest
description: This festival brings national and international brewers to the gardens by the river, featuring live music, DJs, and street food.
longDescription:
The Porto Beer Fest is an annual gathering dedicated to craft beer, taking place over four days from June 18th to June 21st, 2026. This event showcases a selection of both Portuguese and international breweries, offering a range of styles and flavours. It serves as a platform for brewers to present their products and for the public to discover new and established labels within the craft beer scene.

Attendees can expect an outdoor festival atmosphere set within the Alfândega do Porto Gardens, located alongside the Douro River. The event incorporates a programme of live musical performances and DJ sets throughout its duration. Complementing the beverages, various street food vendors will be present, providing food options for visitors. The setting offers views of the river and Gaia.

Entry to the Porto Beer Fest is free for all visitors. The Alfândega do Porto Gardens are accessible via public transport; it is a short walk from the Alfândega bus stop, served by several STCP lines. The venue is also within walking distance of the historic Ribeira district.
